status: DESIGN: informal implementable data contract, with a small reference implementation in atlas.py
object_universe: nonempty finite ordinary tournaments; converse not identified
adjacency_convention: A[i,j]=1 iff i points to j; diagonal zero

linear.quotient_bits: lexicographic pair bits in the canonical transitive order; all 1
linear.children: at least two strong children in source-to-sink order; no linear child

prime.quotient_bits: lexicographic unordered-pair bits; 1 means earlier port points to later port
prime.children: at least three recursively canonical children; normalize quotient and children jointly under all port permutations

canonical_tree.prime_semantics: quotient must be indecomposable; storing a nonprime here is invalid
canonical_tree.reference_canonicalization: lexicographically minimize sorted-key compact JSON of quotient bits plus ordered canonical children over permitted port permutations
canonical_tree.complexity_warning: atlas.py uses all subsets and all quotient permutations, not a polynomial-time implementation

named_boundary.ports: ordered distinct vertex addresses, each a leaf path in the current materialized tree
named_boundary.rooted_equivalence: isomorphism maps port j to port j
named_boundary.seam: explicit list of cross-child arc reversals with two endpoint addresses each
named_boundary.post_edit: recompute canonical decomposition before unmarked class counting; translate port addresses through the chosen materialization map

observer_states.symmetry: child automorphism groups plus exact child-isotype-colored quotient stabilizer; order alone if only order is requested
observer_states.hamiltonian_uniform: integer vector q[r] of ordered nonempty r-path covers, r=1..n
observer_states.hamiltonian_rooted: q refined by ordered start/end port-or-star labels for every path; retain singleton endpoint coincidences
observer_states.spectrum_uniform: adjacency characteristic polynomial f(z); derive g=(-1)^n f(-z-1)-f(z)
observer_states.spectrum_rooted: f plus U^t(zI-A)^-1 U where columns of U are all-ones and selected port vectors
observer_states.parity_full_dynamics: invariant factors of tI-A over F2[t], not just characteristic polynomial
observer_states.inventory: per-observer class multiplicity and reciprocal-automorphism mass, with actual symmetry sidecars if finer census requested

uniform_substitution.required: actual quotient orientation and typed child states

rooted_seam.required: materialized endpoint identities and valid tournament arc changes

mod_p.lost: integer precision and potentially distinctions between characteristic polynomials

classification_frontiers.all_finite_tournaments: complete normal form with infinite prime alphabet
classification_frontiers.finite_prime_alphabet: complete scoped family; at most exponential number of ordinary classes
classification_frontiers.arbitrary_infinite_behavior: not a finite catalogue; specify update rule and equivalence
classification_frontiers.chan_pak: OPEN; constructor grammars and finite coverage are not all-target proof
